text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once again, summer training camp has 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, let's hit up that candy shop later! 
Huh? Come on, what's wrong with grabbing a 
quick snack~?”

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior B
text_block_list.text:
――A 10-person room sounds like a drag. 
Isn't there an empty room? Let's just 
crash there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And just like always, Sirius Symboli's 
juniors are as wildly carefree as ever."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Those guys are talking smack again. So 
annoying...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Aren't those Sirius Symboli's lackeys? 
They look like total delinquents...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "...*yawn* Damn, I'm sleepy."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As for Sirius Symboli, she didn't seem 
particularly bothered by her 
underclassmen's free-spiritedness or the 
criticisms. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior C
text_block_list.text:
—So sleepy... I'm gonna take a nap around 
here before I go. 'Night~.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior D
text_block_list.text:
—Apparently there's a cave up in the 
mountains. Wouldn't it be a blast to check 
it out at night?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Napping under the blazing sun, midnight 
cave exploration...
choice_data_list:
(Isn't that a little too dangerous, 
though...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was fretting over whether I 
should stop them--

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Oi, you guys.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text: What is it, Sirius-san?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If it's what you guys chose and decided 
on, I don't care what you do. Howeverâ

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Make sure you look after your own damn 
self."

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, you guys suddenly spoke in 
unison.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Damn, Sirius Symboli is something else...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An outlaw boss who makes sure to keep 
everyone in line. I caught a glimpse of 
her imposing presence on the very first 
day of summer camp.
